ModMetaData.name: DMS Synthriada - Scourge Death Fix
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
修复天灾复活后再次死亡时的重复死亡与空尸体报错，同时保护人形机械体无伤害信息死亡时的植入物移除。保留原有复活、次数消耗、掉落与移除回调；不添加存档数据。
Fixes reentrant death and empty-corpse errors when a resurrected Scourge dies again. Also protects implant removal in HumanlikeMech.Kill(null). Preserves resurrection, charge use, drops and removal callbacks. No saved data.
